user.title: Aroma-Link Local
user.description: Devices are discovered automatically from MQTT. Requires Home Assistant's MQTT integration pointed at the broker the devices use, and the devices redirected to it.

abort.already_configured: Aroma-Link Local is already set up.

data_description.query_interval: How often to ask each device for its status and schedule. 0 disables polling.
data_description.uplink_wildcard: MQTT subscription for device messages. Covers the control and telemetry topics.
data_description.downlink_pattern: Command topic. The device topic id is substituted for the id placeholder.

gate_config.title: Gating
gate_config.description: Optional gates for scheduled windows. Without any gate the schedule runs as written. Gating is active only after a schedule was saved from Home Assistant and 'Schedule enabled' is on.

data.keep_fan_on: Keep the fan on while diffusing
data.max_on_minutes: Maximum continuous on time (min, power mode)
data.rest_minutes: Rest after the maximum on time (min)

data_description.climate_entity: Diffuse only while the climate entity reports an active hvac_action, or while the sensor reads at least the start threshold.
data_description.occupancy_entity: Diffuse inside windows only while this entity is on.
data_description.motion_entities: Night Owl runs only after motion within the linger time.
data_description.hvac_on_delay_minutes: HVAC must be active this long before the gate opens.
data_description.hvac_off_delay_minutes: A closed HVAC gate must last this long before diffusing stops.
data_description.occupancy_off_delay_minutes: Occupancy must stay off this long before diffusing stops.
data_description.gating_mode: slots: schedule flip, no power beeps. power: the decision switches power.
data_description.keep_fan_on: Turn the device fan on whenever the gating wants it diffusing.
data_description.hvac_start_threshold: A sensor HVAC entity opens the gate from this value up (e.g. 150 m³/h).
data_description.hvac_stop_threshold: ... and closes it below this value (e.g. 100 m³/h). An unreadable sensor closes the gate.
data_description.block_entities: Smoke, a manual pause, a ventilation boost: any of these on stops diffusing without the off-delays.
data_description.min_off_minutes: After the device was switched off, the gate waits this long before switching it on again (fewer beeps). 0 = off.
data_description.max_on_minutes: Watchdog: after this long on, the device rests. 0 = off.
data_description.rest_minutes: How long the watchdog rest lasts.

abort.no_devices: No Aroma-Link device has been discovered yet. Power-cycle the diffuser and retry.

sync_schedules.name: Sync schedule
sync_schedules.description: Write today's slots to the device now if they differ from the model.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device id, MAC or HA device id (optional with a single device).

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the weekly schedule (Monday=0 ... Sunday=6, up to 4 windows per day).

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Object with a days map, see the README.

import_schedule.name: Import schedule from device
import_schedule.description: Use the device's current slots as the window set of every weekday.

set_night_owl.name: Set Night Owl
set_night_owl.description: Configure Night Owl: the low-intensity run outside the scheduled windows. Per-day permission lives in the schedule (night_owl flag per day).

linger_minutes.name: Motion linger
linger_minutes.description: Minutes Night Owl keeps running after the last motion (gating).

start_timed_run.name: Start timed run
start_timed_run.description: Run the diffuser for a duration regardless of schedule windows. Survives Home Assistant restarts and replaces a run already active.

work_sec.name: Work seconds per cycle
work_sec.description: Defaults to the Work duration setting.

pause_sec.name: Pause seconds per cycle
pause_sec.description: Defaults to the Pause duration setting.

cancel_timed_run.name: Cancel timed run
cancel_timed_run.description: Cancel the auto-off timer. The device keeps running until the schedule or a manual command turns it off.

oil_refill.name: Record oil refill
oil_refill.description: Start a new oil basis (new bottle). Keeps the calibrated usage rate unless told otherwise.

fill_volume.name: Fill volume
fill_volume.description: Millilitres in the bottle (default: bottle capacity).

keep_calibration.name: Keep calibration
keep_calibration.description: Off also forgets the calibrated rate.

oil_calibrate.name: Calibrate oil usage
oil_calibrate.description: start, end (after the measured run), finalize (rate = used oil / pump work since fill), manual (rate, or start/end volumes with runtime hours), or set (store the values only).

action.name: Action
action.description: start, end, finalize, manual or set.

manual_rate_ml_per_hour.name: Manual rate
manual_rate_ml_per_hour.description: ml per hour of pump work.

manual_runtime_hours.name: Manual runtime
manual_runtime_hours.description: Hours of pump work between the two volumes.

send_frame.name: Send raw frame (diagnostics)
send_frame.description: Send one inner frame (start, direction, MAC, command, sub-command, payload, XOR checksum are built for you). Replies are fired as aroma_link_local_frame events (Developer tools, Events).
